entries.name: Sensory Filter
entries.rule_summary: Select one distracting sensory channel for the scene. That distraction alone does not impose Disadvantage or force a roll.

entries.name: Low-Light Adaptation
entries.rule_summary: After brief adjustment, dim light alone does not impose Disadvantage on vision-based Perception; true darkness and concealment still matter.

entries.name: Memory Cueing
entries.rule_summary: Once per scene, recall one reasonably learned or personally observed detail without a roll.

entries.name: Pattern Index
entries.rule_summary: After obtaining at least three relevant clues, ask which two appear connected or which one most clearly fails to fit; answer is bounded by evidence already obtained.

entries.name: Counterintelligence
entries.rule_summary: After meaningful observation, ask one bounded counterintelligence question; the answer must come from detectable evidence.

entries.name: Route Modeling
entries.rule_summary: After surveying known terrain or maps, identify the fastest, safest, or least-observed plausible route among known options.

entries.name: Microexpression Read
entries.rule_summary: After a short face-to-face exchange, identify the target's dominant visible emotional posture; this does not reveal thoughts or guarantee deception detection.

entries.name: Multi-Track Attention
entries.rule_summary: Maintain awareness of two active tasks, targets, or threats without ordinary minor distraction penalties; severe overload can still impose consequences.

entries.name: Evidence Lattice
entries.rule_summary: Once per scene, organize at least four meaningful clues into a provisional timeline or relationship map; the GM identifies one contradiction, missing link, or unresolved relationship exposed by the evidence.

entries.name: Forensic Synthesis Matrix
entries.rule_summary: When directly analyzing evidence in the Mastered investigative Skill's domain, qualifying rolls include its Skill Mastery Die.

entries.name: Predictive Search Model
entries.rule_summary: After establishing a meaningful evidence base, qualifying searches with the Mastered search Skill include the Skill Mastery Die.

entries.name: Distributed Reconstruction
entries.rule_summary: Combine observations from up to three linked allies and ask one bounded question about the shared pattern; receive a truthful answer supported by those observations.

entries.name: Counterfactual Engine
entries.rule_summary: Once per scene after establishing a likely sequence of events, ask what single observed fact would be hardest to explain if that sequence were false.

entries.name: Continuity Lens
entries.rule_summary: Once per mission, make an appropriate Mastery-enabled roll after examining a genuine continuity anomaly or Carrier problem; on success identify one actionable relationship among cause, Carrier, Exposure, and likely downstream consequence.
